# EME World

> EME World is a Fundación (501(c)(3) foundation) that provides an open source, human guided AI harness for organizations, governments and communities. Everyone gets a free My EME, a chat platform with their own AI digital twin (an EME Profile). Trusted by the United Nations, Yale and the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation (CBC).

Key facts:
- 100% open source. Runs on Linux, Docker and Git.
- AI runs on dedicated hardware at a flat rate. Unlimited tokens, no usage charges, full data privacy, no vendor lock in.
- Hosting, open AI models, dedicated GPU and cloud storage are included.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eme.world/): What EME is, the AI harness, EME Profiles, servers and values.
- [Budget](https://eme.world/costs.html): My EME is free. Basic hosting is $150 per month, provided by EnterMediaLibrary.com. Monthly support plans are agreed in a one on one proposal. Explains dedicated hardware instead of per token billing.
- [Architecture](https://eme.world/architecture.html): EME World is the parent server with People and Teams. Each connected EME Server has its own Server Chat Welcome, Collections, Tutorials and Data Tools.
- [Developers](https://eme.world/developers.html): Tutorial for setting up an EME Server and customizing it with OpenCode and AI coding agents.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/entermedia-community/eme-server): The open source EME Server.
